metadata.metaDescription: Explore IDGen's specialized identity services: PVC ID card printing, RFID/NFC credentials, custom satin lanyards, ultrasonic sealing, and cloud identity management.

hero.title: Comprehensive Identity & Credential Services
hero.lede: From 30-mil PVC smart cards and contactless RFID badges to full-color satin lanyards and ultrasonic finishing, IDGen delivers complete wearable identification manufactured under one roof in Guwahati.

cardSection.title: CR80 PVC & RFID Smart Card Printing
cardSection.lede: Engineered for universities, tech parks, hospitals, and events requiring high-definition graphics and security encoding.

lanyardSection.title: Custom Lanyards & Finishing Services
lanyardSection.lede: Direct factory dye-sublimation and ultrasonic welding for comfortable, tear-proof daily identification.

accessoriesTeaser.title: Looking for ID Card Holders & Hardware Hooks?
accessoriesTeaser.lede: Complete your card setup with crystal acrylic cases, horizontal/vertical four-side-lock holders, and anti-rust swivel carabiners manufactured for maximum durability.

ctaBand.title: Need custom printing specifications or combined kits?
ctaBand.body: Contact our technical production team to review card samples, RFID reader compatibility, and custom lanyard artwork proofs.

services.title: PVC ID Card Printing
services.shortDescription: High-resolution thermal retransfer and direct-to-card PVC printing for schools, universities, hospitals, and corporate organizations.

services.title: Student ID Card Printing
services.shortDescription: High-volume student identification for schools and colleges, featuring automated roster imports, batch photo cropping, and library barcodes.
services.imageSrc: /images/Order Deliver/Don Bosco Hr Sec School, gojapara 1.png
services.imageAlt: Student ID Card Printing Service for Schools

services.title: Employee ID Card Printing
services.shortDescription: Corporate employee badges with RFID turnstile integration, executive finishes, department color bands, and security holograms.
services.imageSrc: /images/ID Card Full Set Samples/High-quality Employee ID Cards and Staff Identity Cards delivered to clients in Guwahati and Assam.jpg

services.title: Custom Printed Satin Lanyards
services.shortDescription: Full-color dye-sublimated 20mm satin lanyards with sharp continuous logo printing, safety breakaways, and heavy-duty swivel dog hooks.

services.title: Event & Conference Badges
services.shortDescription: Oversized VIP passes, delegate badges, and accreditation credentials with dual-hook anti-twist lanyards and fast event turnaround.
services.imageAlt: Event & Conference Badge Printing with Dual Hooks

services.title: RFID & NFC Smart Card Printing
services.shortDescription: 13.56 MHz (Mifare, DESFire, NTAG) and 125 kHz contactless smart cards customized with high-security encoding and durable lamination.

services.title: Precision Ultrasonic Sealing
services.shortDescription: Acoustic high-frequency welding that seamlessly bonds lanyard ribbon loops, delivering 18kg+ pull resistance with zero staples or loose threads.
services.imageAlt: Ultrasonic Sealing of Lanyards by IDGen

services.title: Membership & Loyalty Cards
services.shortDescription: Premium VIP club membership cards with embossed foil stamping, magnetic stripes, smart chips, and luxury matte or gloss surfaces.
